# Security policy

Report vulnerabilities privately using [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/jarymor-ux/kee-route-manager/security/advisories/new). Do not attach live subscriptions, credentials, UUIDs, router backups or diagnostic archives to public issues.

Only the newest RC receives fixes during release preparation. The current prerelease line remains experimental pending its documented hardware acceptance. Automatic update application is disabled; explicit installation is permitted only through the signed stable-launcher flow. See [security boundaries](../docs/SECURITY.md) and [known limitations](../docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md).
